name: FunnelChart
label: Funnel chart
description: Ordered funnel stages as centred trapezoid bands, each sized by its share of the first stage.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the values, tooltips and value axis are written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered stages, first stage widest. Each later stage's width is its share of the first.

props.name: title
props.description:
Chart title, in the shared chart header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which FunnelChart does not expose.

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (border, padding, fill) when the chart sits inside another panel that supplies the surface

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Shows each stage's name beside its band. Turn off when a legend under the chart already carries the names.

props.name: summaryLabel
props.description:
The chart's accessible name, summarising every stage, given `data` when it
holds at least one stage. Defaults to "Funnel: " then each stage's label and
reading (its `displayValue`, else the value in the reader's locale),
comma-separated, e.g. "Funnel: Visits 12,400, Sign-ups 3,100".

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: The chart's accessible name when `data` is empty. Defaults to "Funnel, no data".

props.name: minStageShare
props.description: Floor percentage from the stepped-bar rendering this chart used to have.
props.deprecated:
The funnel now draws true trapezoids sized by value, so a
height floor no longer applies; the prop is ignored.
